description: Ordered causal chain for ATP6AP2-related disorder, with evidence level marked per step
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(15.5, 10.2))
ax.set_xlim(0, 100); ax.set_ylim(0, 100); ax.axis("off")

DEM = "#2166ac"   # demonstrated in human cells or patient tissue
MOD = "#1a9850"   # demonstrated in model organism only
INF = "#b2182b"   # inferred

def box(x, y, w, h, text, color, fs=9.2):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.6",
                                linewidth=1.6, edgecolor=color, facecolor=color+"18"))
    ax.text(x+w/2, y+h/2, text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fs, color="#111111")

def arrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, label="", color="#555555"):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2), arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=15,
                                 linewidth=1.4, color=color, shrinkA=2, shrinkB=2))
    if label:
        ax.text((x1+x2)/2 + 1.2, (y1+y2)/2, label, fontsize=8, color=color,
                style="italic", ha="left", va="center")

# --- trunk, steps 1-5 ---
box(26, 90, 48, 7.5, "1  ATP6AP2 variant at Xp11.4 (hypomorphic only: splice-modulating\nsynonymous/intronic, or partial-function missense)", DEM)
box(26, 80, 48, 7.5, "2  leads to exon 2 or exon 4 skipping, or reduced protein stability\n(RNA-seq in patient fibroblasts and iPSC-NPCs: PMID 35779466, 41131679)", DEM)
box(26, 70, 48, 7.5, "3  results in ~50% loss of full-length ATP6AP2 protein\n(gene dosage, not dominant negative: cDNA rescue, PMID 30985297)", DEM)
box(26, 60, 48, 7.5, "4  results in failed V0 assembly in the ER: lost binding to ATP6AP1,\nVMA21, ATP6V0D1 (PMID 29127204, 29995586)", DEM)
box(26, 50, 48, 7.5, "5  leads to fewer functional V-ATPase holoenzymes delivered to\nGolgi, endosomes, lysosomes and synaptic vesicles", DEM)
for y in (90, 80, 70, 60): arrow(50, y, 50, y-2.5)

# --- branch point at step 5 -> three arms ---
arrow(50, 50, 50, 47)
ax.text(50, 45.5, "6  branches into three arms", ha="center", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")

# arm A: glycosylation / liver
box(1.5, 30, 29, 11, "6a  under-acidified Golgi leads to mislocalised\nglycosyltransferases, giving N- and O-hypo-\nglycosylation (type II transferrin pattern).\nDemonstrated in patient serum: PMID 29127204,\nand in splicing patients too: PMID 41131679", DEM, fs=8.6)
# arm B: autophagy / mTOR
box(35.5, 30, 29, 11, "6b  under-acidified lysosome leads to blocked\nautophagic flux (p62 and LC3-II accumulate)\nand altered mTORC1 signalling.\nMouse liver and fly fat body: PMID 29127204,\n28129027, 40813582", MOD, fs=8.6)
# arm C: Wnt
box(69.5, 30, 29, 11, "6c  loss of the Frizzled/LRP6 to V-ATPase\nadaptor leads to reduced canonical Wnt and\nPCP signalling.\nXenopus and Drosophila: PMID 20093472,\n20579879, 20579883, 23292348", MOD, fs=8.6)
arrow(50, 45, 16, 41.5); arrow(50, 45, 50, 41.5); arrow(50, 45, 84, 41.5)

# --- step 7: cellular consequence ---
box(1.5, 18, 29, 8, "7a  results in hepatocyte vacuolation,\nsteatosis, cirrhosis; defective immuno-\nglobulin and CD4+ T cell output", MOD, fs=8.6)
box(35.5, 18, 29, 8, "7b  results in neuronal and synaptic\nprotein clearance failure, synapse loss,\nprogressive neuronal death", MOD, fs=8.6)
box(69.5, 18, 29, 8, "7c  results in impaired neural progenitor\ndifferentiation and cortical patterning\n(inferred for human from Xenopus/fly)", INF, fs=8.6)
for x in (16, 50, 84): arrow(x, 30, x, 26.5)

# --- step 8: clinical ---
box(1.5, 6, 29, 8, "8a  ATP6AP2-CDG (OMIM 301045):\nhepatopathy, cutis laxa, immuno-\ndeficiency, mild ID", DEM, fs=8.6)
box(35.5, 6, 29, 8, "8b  XPDS (OMIM 300911): adult\nparkinsonism with spasticity, and\nMRXSH late-course parkinsonism", DEM, fs=8.6)
box(69.5, 6, 29, 8, "8c  MRXSH (OMIM 300423): infantile\nID, epilepsy, cerebral and cerebellar\natrophy, thin corpus callosum", DEM, fs=8.6)
for x in (16, 50, 84): arrow(x, 18, x, 14.5)
# cross links showing the arms converge on each phenotype
arrow(30.5, 10, 35.5, 10, color="#999999"); arrow(64.5, 10, 69.5, 10, color="#999999")
ax.text(50, 2.4, "grey arrows: the three arms are not phenotype-specific. Raynor 2025 (PMID 41131679) found the glycosylation defect of arm 6a\n"
                 "in splicing patients with a purely neurological presentation, so allele severity sets the phenotype, not which arm is engaged.",
        ha="center", fontsize=8.4, style="italic", color="#444444")

h = [plt.Line2D([0],[0], color=c, lw=4) for c in (DEM, MOD, INF)]
ax.legend(h, ["demonstrated in human patient cells or tissue",
              "demonstrated in model organism only",
              "inferred, not directly demonstrated"],
          loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.0), fontsize=9, frameon=False)
ax.set_title("ATP6AP2-related disorder: ordered causal chain from variant to phenotype",
             fontsize=13.5, loc="left", pad=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
